observations: Photo shows a PlayStation-style controller (dual analog sticks, face buttons, D-pad) on top of a black box.
The box has the text 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON' watermark, but no visible PS4 model/console details.
No clear photo of the PS4 console itself, no ports, no screen, no storage label, and no game discs/cases.

claims.claim: Ps4 fat hacked with fc26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Only a controller and a generic box are visible; no PS4 console photo, no firmware/modchip evidence, and no game list/discs shown.

risks.risk: The item may not be a PS4 console (could be only a controller or a different bundle).
risks.proof: A photo of the actual PS4 console (front + back ports) with the model/serial label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed PS4 console (worst case: controller-only value).

risks.risk: Hacked/modded status (e.g., 'fc26') cannot be verified from the photo; could be claimed without working setup.
risks.proof: A short video showing the console booting to the hacked menu/dashboard and launching one of the listed games.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/unknown software state (worst case: treat as standard/untested console).

risks.risk: Game availability (8 other games) is not shown; could be missing, corrupted, or only on the seller’s account.
risks.proof: Photos of the game list on-screen (library) or discs/cases, plus a video launching two different games.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst case: no games included).

risks.risk: Condition/defects (overheating, noisy fan, faulty disc drive, missing accessories) are not visible.
risks.proof: Video of the console running for 10–15 minutes and a photo of included accessories (power cable, HDMI, controller).
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing possible repairs/untested (worst case: discount heavily).

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 FAT console front and back ports (with serial/model label readable).
Video booting the console and showing the hacked/modded dashboard (if applicable).
Photo/video showing the installed game list (or discs/cases) including the one named 'fc26' and at least two others.
Photo of what accessories are included (power cable, HDMI, controller model, any extra controllers).
Video test: launch one game and show it running (audio + gameplay) for a few minutes.
response.reason: From the photo, the PS4 console and the claimed hacked/game details are not verifiable. Without proof of the console model/condition and the game/mod status, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
